It sits at the Advanced tier of the teaching ladder, where each idea earns its place before the next is introduced. Signature-authored and Signature-labeled throughout.
overview: In the Signature teaching of real estate basics, The Future of Real Estate Basics is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. Closing costs means 2-5% beyond the down payment Landlording means screen tenants and know the law Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Advanced material that follows.
core_concepts: Closing costs: 2-5% beyond the down payment
Landlording: screen tenants and know the law
key_laws: Never skip the inspection.
Location first; everything else can be changed.
vocabulary: Equity: the value you actually own
Escrow: the neutral holding of money in the transaction
methods: Sell method: price from comps, stage and photograph well, negotiate repairs reasonably
history: Real estate brokerage professionalized in the early 1900s; the MLS, 30-year mortgage, and modern disclosure laws shaped today’s market.
key_points: Closing costs: 2-5% beyond the down payment
Landlording: screen tenants and know the law
Key vocabulary: Equity — the value you actually own; Escrow — the neutral holding of money in the transaction.
Governing principle: Never skip the inspection.
how_it_works: The Signature learner approaches The Future of Real Estate Basics by anchoring it to what is already known: Equity (the value you actually own), then Escrow (the neutral holding of money in the transaction). The working method is Sell method: price from comps, stage and photograph well, negotiate repairs reasonably Practice means rehearsing the idea until it can be reconstructed from scratch, which is exactly what the accompanying study program drills.
requirements: Reader needs no prior background: every term used here is defined in this entry or in the Foundations tier entries before it.
standards: Standard curricula, textbooks, and professional references for real estate basics.
citations: Signature-authored fundamentals for Real Estate Basics
provenance: Signature-authored fundamentals written for the JAH Signature system; speculative or interpretive content is Signature-labeled.
licensing: Public facts; original presentation. Property of Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
